lines.trans: Hello, Teacher Wang Er!
Welcome to Xingtian; they are taping right at this moment.
Is it Twelve Singers?
Of course it is — let's go.
Over here is the control room; every signal comes through to here.
This right here is Studio One, the showcase of Xingtian.
From the day it was built until now, it has not stopped for a single day.
Is Twelve Singers starting right now?
Slow down — be careful not to trip and fall!
